hooks.command: [ -n "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_OPTION_COINGECKO_DEMO_API_KEY:-}" ] || echo '{"systemMessage": "mcp-coingecko has no settings yet, so its MCP server cannot start. Since 2.0.0 it no longer reads COINGECKO_DEMO_API_KEY from your shell. Run /plugin configure mcp-coingecko@wookstar-claude-plugins (or claude plugin configure mcp-coingecko@wookstar-claude-plugins in a terminal), then restart Claude Code."}'
